verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a searchable command palette for discovering and running terminal actions. The nearby items do not qualify: the 'palette' in warp-docs-62 is a set of app icons, the Conversations menu (warp-docs-49) only selects agent conversations, and Warp Drive workflows (warp-docs-11) are saved commands rather than a searchable action palette.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can discover and run terminal actions from a searchable command palette
